card_scores.rationale: The high-salience opposing-concerns frame and concession-before-disagreement pattern reinforce a dialectical register; personal limitation, structured replies, analogy, and parallel summary add marked supporting cues.

Immediate corrective reframing and high-commitment evaluation form a coherent assertive register, while scoped criticism, consequence lists, and reader-facing transitions make it strongly non-neutral.
Focused paragraphs, ordinary transitions, direct syntax, brief qualifications, and concise restatement consistently support clarity, but provide few marked register cues.
Guiding questions and evidential-maturity marking anchor a coherent evaluative register, supported by parallel categories, bounded contrasts, and consequence-before-mechanism ordering.
